name: PAX TECUM
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of Peace, Perfect Peace (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Peace_Perfect_Peace/, “Pax Tecum”, George T. Caldbeck, arr. by Charles J. Vincent), whose music it marks public domain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org’s incipit 55555 66655 51232 (https://hymnary.org/tune/pax_tecum_caldbeck) and CCEH’s ssssslllss|sdrmrdlssfm (https://www.ccel.org/cceh/0007/x000769.htm). No hand fixes. The year 1877 is CCEH’s (“George Thomas Caldbeck arr., harm., Dr. Charles Vincent, 1877”; Timeless Truths gives 1876, hymnary.org 1878); Caldbeck’s dates (1852–1918) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/pax_tecum_caldbeck and Vincent’s (1852–1934) from https://hymnary.org/person/Vincent_Charles.
